SELECT 
  indicator_bundle->'technical'->>'rsi_14' as rsi,
  indicator_bundle->'technical'->>'macd_hist' as macd,
  indicator_bundle->'technical'->>'bollinger_width_pct' as bb_width,
  indicator_bundle->'sentiment'->>'signal' as tech_meter

SELECT 
  CAST(indicator_bundle->'technical'->>'rsi_14' AS real) as rsi_indicator,
  CAST(indicator_bundle->'technical'->>'macd_hist' AS real) as macd_line,
  CAST(indicator_bundle->'technical'->>'bollinger_width_pct' AS real) as bollinger_band_width,
  indicator_bundle->'sentiment'->>'signal' as technical_meter_direction,
  ROUND(
    (ABS(CAST(indicator_bundle->'technical'->>'rsi_14' AS numeric) - 50) 
     + ABS(CAST(indicator_bundle->'technical'->>'macd_hist' AS numeric)) 
     + (CAST(indicator_bundle->'technical'->>'bollinger_width_pct' AS numeric) * 0.01)) / 3 
    * CASE 
        WHEN indicator_bundle->'sentiment'->>'signal' = 'Buy' THEN 1
        WHEN indicator_bundle->'sentiment'->>'signal' = 'Sell' THEN -1
        ELSE 0
      END
  , 2) as technical_signal_strength
FROM analyticsindicators
LIMIT 10;
